caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular quilt with a white background featuring thin, vertical, grayish lines and diamond-shaped quilting patterns throughout. The quilt is decorated with numerous eight-pointed star motifs arranged in rows. The stars are composed of small diamond shapes in various colors including red, green, yellow, blue, brown, and pink, with each star’s points alternating between two colors. The upper half of the quilt shows smaller stars closely spaced in a grid. In the lower portion, larger stars are placed, with one predominantly green and red star at the bottom left, a brown and light blue star at the bottom right, a pink and brown star at the upper left, and a red and yellow star at the upper right. A red-brown border lines the left and bottom edges, with the left corner smoothly rounded. The background within the quilt diamonds is lightly shaded, giving texture to the drawing.
title: Crib Quilt
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
